Name: JP's Move Animals Between Farms
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][center][color=#00ffff][size=6][b][i][u]Animals Free-Range[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/center]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because having several farms is difficult, at least this way it won't become impossible...
[/i][/b][/size][/color]

[size=4][b]It couldn't be simpler:[/b] when moving an animal from one building to another, you can also move it between maps that have at least [color=#00ff00]one building suitable[/color] for the animal you are moving. A sign with all available maps will appear, and you can choose which one you want to move it to.

You know the rest: move around the map looking for the building where you want to place the animal, and that's it![/size]


[color=#00ff00][size=5]And that's it, a technical mod that adds another possibility to the gameplay. Among other maps, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29276]Farm Central Mod[/url], which is good for weaker devices. Instead of adding one ultra-large map, it adds several maps similar to the Standard Farm.[/size][/color][i][size=5][size=4]
